title: Quark: Quilts n' Stains
description: Reimplements the Stained Planks and Quilted Wool from Quark 1.16.5
body:
Reiimplements the Quilted Wool and Stained Planks from Quark 1.16.5 to MInecraft 1.20.1.

Currently, Quilted Wool comes in two forms, block and carpet. It can be crafted from 3 wool and 2 string to get 3 quilted wool.

 

Stained Planks come in all 16 colors and can be made into slabs, stairs, buttons, pressure plates, fences, and fence gates.
